role: Gate B amount-based strategy authorization state and deterministic shared-capacity allocation kernel for the first multi-strategy oil runtime.
invariants: strategy authorization is authoritative in USD and never automatically rescaled to preserve a percentage
an authorization amendment does not directly mutate strategy-book or formal-account positions
risk-increasing orders require a positive amount authorization but risk-reducing and mandatory orders remain eligible
internal crosses are zero-sum across strategy books and never consume external market turnover
external parent orders equal the sum of strategy external fill allocations by named contract
atomic multi-leg order groups preserve their integer leg ratios
formal-account ending positions equal opening formal positions plus external parent orders
the sum of ending strategy-book positions equals formal-account ending positions by named contract
single-contract trade limits, single-contract position limits, the all-contract gross position cap, and the optional aggregate initial-margin cap are enforced on the one formal account
input order and mapping order cannot change the deterministic allocation result
